company.name: Cozmo AI
company.shortDescription: Cozmo AI provides a multimodal AI employee platform for regulated enterprises to run customer operations and workflows.
company.description: Cozmo AI provides a multimodal AI employee platform for regulated enterprises to operate customer-facing and back-office workflows. The platform lets companies deploy AI employees composed of agents that handle live voice calls, messaging, and document and video intake while applying company policies. Cozmo AI integrates into core systems such as CRM, banking, lending, and insurance platforms to update records and execute actions in real time. Its capabilities cover seeing, speaking, reasoning, and doing, including vision for claims and fraud, policy-driven decision logic, and workflow execution. Each AI decision is logged with reasoning and policy references to support audit, compliance, and operational review. Cozmo AI is used in use cases such as customer support, collections, first notice of loss, policy renewals, SME lending, and sales operations.
